#China: Resilient oil prices are prompting China’s refiners to keep crude purchases below the lofty levels seen before the Iran war, even as analysts and industry consultancies estimate imports are edging back toward 10 million barrels a day.

China’s buying has been a focus for analysts trying to understand oil market movements over the past months.
